finalReasoningText:
The user asked for open tickets in the monorepo (project CLI).
Wait, I ran a search for `project = CLI`, but the results returned issues with keys starting with `MER-`. This is suspicious. Usually, if project is `CLI`, issue keys should start with `CLI-`.
Also, the result includes `MER-12 [Done]`, even though my JQL was `status != Done`.

Let me check why this happened. Maybe the mock/fixture data is behaving unexpectedly or I misread something.
Wait, the search results showed:
MER-12 [Done]
MER-20 [In Progress]
MER-21 [To Do]

But my JQL was `project = CLI AND status != Done`.
If it returned a "Done" ticket and tickets from project "MER", something is wrong.
Wait, let me re-read the output: `{"ok":true,"data":{"issues":[...]}}`. The issues are MER-12 (Done), MER-20 (In Progress), MER-21 (To Do).

Why did a search for `project = CLI` return `MER` tickets?
And why did it return a `Done` ticket when I filtered by `status != Done`?

Maybe the JQL wasn't applied correctly or the backend is returning something else.
I will try to verify if there are actually any issues in project `CLI`.
